name: Reaper Skull Puffball

items.name: Motion Sense 60 feet
items.text: The monster senses motion through vibrations and air movement.

items.name: Spore Explosion
items.text:
When the reaper skull puffball dies, it explodes, dealing 8d8 poison damage to each creature in a 20-foot emanation (DC 28 basic Fortitude save save).

Creatures that fail their save are exposed to skull rot.

items.name: Paralysis
items.text: A creature hit by the puffball's tendril must succeed a DC 28 Fortitude save save or become Paralyzed. The paralyzed creature can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns.

items.name: Skull Rot
items.text:
Saving Throw DC 28 Fortitude save

---

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 1d8 poison damage plus Enfeebled 2 (1 round)

Stage 2 2d8 poison damage plus enfeebled 2 and Drained 1 (1 round)

Stage 3 3d8 poison damage plus enfeebled 2 and Drained 2 (1d4 rounds)

items.name: Spore Cloud
items.text:
The puffball releases a 30-foot cone of spores that deals 4d8 poison damage (DC 28 basic Fortitude save save) to creatures in the cone.

Creatures that fail this save are also exposed to skull rot.

text:
Many benign puffball fungi cling to the detritus of forest floors in Darklands caverns. These fungi's giant versions are more mobile and dangerous.

---

When this fungus detects prey, its tendrils writhe and exude a paralytic toxin.
